name: Can I fix a sewage smell myself, or do I need a plumber?

mainEntity.name: Can I fix a sewage smell myself, or do I need a plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some minor causes of sewage smells, like a dry P-trap (easily fixed by running water), can be addressed by a homeowner. However, many issues, such as significant clogs requiring hydro-jetting, damaged vent pipes, or a faulty toilet wax ring, typically require professional plumbing expertise. Attempting complex repairs without proper knowledge can lead to further damage. If the smell persists, contacting a plumber is advisable.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can fix minor issues like a dry P-trap, but complex problems like major clogs or vent pipe damage usually require a professional plumber.
